facts.text: I saw a house that I really love on 3/1 and I am considering making an offer.
I got pre-approved for a mortgage on February 10th.
I am working with an agent named Rachel.
The house I saw on March 1st checks all the boxes for my criteria.
I am considering making my offer contingent on an inspection.
I was thinking of offering around $320,000.
The asking price of the house is $335,000.
I plan to attach my pre-approval letter to the offer.
I think $320,000 is a fair price considering the market value of the property.
I am confident that the inspection contingency will protect me if any issues are found.
I am prepared to negotiate and I am hoping to come to a mutually beneficial agreement with the seller.
I will submit the offer today.
Rachel will present the offer to the seller.
I will include the pre-approval letter and the inspection contingency in the offer.
I will include all necessary documents in the offer.
